newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs June index rises to 61.5.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs June index rises to 61.5.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 61.5 in June from 56.8 in May, Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said Monday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index fell to 53.7 in June from 56.9 in May.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 57.1 in June from 53.6 in May.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)

Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the business barometer continued to show economic growth, posting a strong, 4.7-point rise. Production rose sharply, reaching the highest level since February 1995, while new orders also showed strength. Employment resumed its steady advance.
However, supplier deliveries and price paid "settled toward neutral," pulling back toward 50, the group said.
